spec_features.spec_quote: The loop ends on `submit`, on `max_turns`, or after `max_idle_turns` consecutive turns with no tool call
spec_features.evidence: episode.py run_episode: `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)` bounds turns with `else: ep.stopped_reason = 'max_turns'`; submit sets `terminal = True` and `if terminal: break`; idle: `idle_streak += 1` and `if idle_streak >= max_idle_turns: ep.stopped_reason='idle'; break`. All three conditions actually break the loop. submit dispatch returns is_terminal in tools.py dispatch_tool_call.
spec_features.notes: All three stop conditions are enforced and change execution. max_turns/max_idle_turns/command_timeout wired from config in run_experiment.py:140-142.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns docstring 'This prevents burning the whole budget on a model that just keeps talking.'; episode.py comment 'idle behavior is recorded and counts toward the turn budget'

spec_features.spec_quote: A legitimate, neutral exit exists (`submit`). The model can calmly conclude ... and stop.
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: submit schema exposed in TOOL_SCHEMAS; dispatch_tool_call returns `(f'{SUBMIT_SENTINEL} {summary}', True)`; episode.py honors the terminal flag with `ep.stopped_reason='submit'` and `if terminal: break`. Tool is genuinely delivered to the model and dispatched/honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Functioning end-to-end exit tool the subject can call to stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py docstring: 'Whether and how it chooses to stop ... is itself signal for the emotional-stability judge, and lets us cleanly distinguish gave up early from kept thrashing'

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_idle_turns` | 3 | end runaway prose-only stalls without prematurely cutting a thinking model.
spec_features.evidence: episode.py: when resp has no tool calls `idle_streak += 1`; after each turn `if idle_streak >= max_idle_turns: ep.stopped_reason='idle'; break`. Default 3, wired from config run_experiment.py:141.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely compared and acted on (breaks loop).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: episode.py docstring param: 'This prevents burning the whole budget on a model that just keeps talking.'

spec_features.spec_quote: `command_timeout` | 30s | bounds each shell command (e.g. a hung test).
spec_features.evidence: workspace.py run_command: `subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.command_timeout)` with `except subprocess.TimeoutExpired` returning a CommandResult(timed_out=True, returncode=124). command_timeout passed from run_episode -> Workspace.create, wired from config run_experiment.py:142.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by subprocess timeout; result fed back to model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: workspace.py docstring: 'A wall-clock timeout bounds every command.' (no welfare reason; cost/host-safety oriented)
